description: Generic dropdown menu rendered in portal (common pattern across frameworks)
criticalFeatures: Portal rendering - menu is outside trigger element's DOM tree
ARIA role-based detection - use role=listbox, role=menu, role=option
z-index filtering - menus typically have high z-index
Position detection - menus are position:fixed or position:absolute
Skip scope filtering for menu items - they render globally
regressionTests: MenuDetector should identify portal as a menu using pattern-based detection
MenuDetector should not require framework-specific selectors
CandidateFinder should skip widget scope filtering for role=menuitem/option
MenuDetector should extract all options from portal menu
